paper_coverage_interpretation: Strict statement-by-statement manuscript coverage, including the full real-parameter background ALT and the unused intermediates of replaced proofs, is not claimed. All required main conclusions and their dependencies are proved.
proved_scope: Symmetric Lie-Trotter operator-norm convergence for arbitrary complex matrices F,G in every positive finite dimension, with no commutativity assumption; the m*k power limit holds for every natural m.
The actual fractional CFC-power Trotter product in (3.2) converges to exp(m*(log D+log B)) for positive definite D,B.
Lemma 3.1 (CLBRIDGE): paperL(n,m,A,B)<=paperT(n,m,A,B) for every pair of positive integers n,m and positive definite A,B.
The complete region of Corollary 2.3, including all positive boundary degrees with min(n,m)<=2 and all six specified finite pairs.
The complete six-pair PSD strong clause of Corollary 2.3, including singular inputs.
The full p54>=U54>=T54>=L54 chain and p54=L54 iff A*B=B*A for positive definite inputs.
The actual exponential trace is real and nonnegative, so reTrace comparisons match the manuscript trace statements.
proof_method: First-order derivatives at the identity, local linear norm bounds, noncommuting power-difference norm estimates, and the proved ALT families. No matrix-logarithm series convergence assumption is used.
